column2: Check the camera ribbon on the ESP32-CAM: its end is fully in the socket and the socket's black lock is pressed down. Your camera ribbon is marked OV3660 (3 MP); the code already supports it.
Plug the ESP32-CAM onto the MB: camera facing up, all 16 pins in the MB's sockets. The 5V and GND labels on the ESP32-CAM line up with the same pins on the MB.
Plug the MB's micro-USB into the laptop. Port not showing? The MB uses a CH340 chip: install the CH340 driver.
In the Arduino IDE: Board → AI Thinker ESP32-CAM, Partition Scheme → Huge APP, choose the port.
Open robot_mata.ino. Fill in WIFI_NAMA and WIFI_PASSWORD with your 2.4 GHz home WiFi.
Upload. If it stops at "Connecting....": hold the IO0 button on the MB, press RST once, release IO0 after the upload percentage appears.
When done, press RST on the MB. Open the Serial Monitor at 115200 and note the IP address that appears.
Open the camera's IP address in a phone or laptop browser (example http://192.168.1.50). A "Mata robot" page with one photo appears.
Try /stream: the video runs, about 5-15 frames per second.
Try /flash?on=1 then /flash?on=0.
Image upside down? Change KAMERA_TERBALIK to true, upload again.
So the camera's address does not change, open the router settings and give a fixed address (DHCP reservation) to the device named esp32-... or robotcam. Note that address for Part 5.
Battery switch OFF. Unplug the ESP32-CAM from the MB.

Cut 26 AWG red and black, 31 cm (no. 23) each (from LM2596 #2 on level 1 up to the head on level 3, with slack for the head to turn). Solder one end of each to a 3 cm female jumper piece, heat shrink. Red: LM2596 #2 OUT+ → the ESP32-CAM 5V pin. Black: OUT− → the GND pin beside it. The ends without a jumper are clamped in the screw terminal.
Never use the ESP32-CAM's VCC or 3V3 pin to feed in power. VCC is an output, not an input.

A 1000 µF capacitor near the ESP32-CAM, between 5V and GND: solder its legs to the red and black wires about 3 cm before the female jumper (long leg to red), then insulate. The wire is over 20 cm, so the capacitor must be at the camera end, not at the LM2596.
Switch ON. Wait 10 seconds, then open the camera's IP address in the browser: the photo still shows.

The ESP32-CAM has no bolt holes, so strap it to the front mount of the pan-tilt head with 2 cable ties: one across the very top edge (above the camera, through the SD slot), one across the ESP32-CAM label area under the ribbon connector. Do not cross the lens, the flash LED or the ribbon connector. Nylon does not disturb the antenna; only metal does. Tighten just enough that it does not wobble.
In Telegram, search for @BotFather, send /newbot, give a name (for example Robi Robot) and a username ending in "bot". Save the token you are given.
Search for @userinfobot, press Start, save your Id number. The robot will only obey this ID.
Open your new bot and press Start.
Already made a bot for the weather station? Make a new bot for the robot, so the two do not fight over messages.
Install the UniversalTelegramBot (Brian Lough) and ArduinoJson (Benoit Blanchon) libraries.
Fill in the WiFi, token and chat ID in the test code, upload to the S3, then send a message to the bot.
Fill in the key in the test code, upload to the S3, type a question in the Serial Monitor.
Open console.groq.com, sign up, then API Keys → Create API Key. Copy the key (it starts with gsk_).
The brain code sends a 4-second recording (WAV 16 kHz) to the whisper-large-v3-turbo model with the language set to Indonesian, and receives the text.

The ESP32-audioI2S library is not in the Library Manager. Open its releases page, download the ZIP of version 4.0.0 (Source code zip). In the Arduino IDE: Sketch → Include Library → Add .ZIP Library, choose that ZIP file.
Make sure LovyanGFX, UniversalTelegramBot and ArduinoJson are installed.
Change NAMA_ROBOT and NAMA_PEMILIK as you like.
Set Tools as in Part 3 Stage 1 (PSRAM: OPI PSRAM, Huge APP). Upload. The first compile can take a few minutes.
After the first power-up, the display asks for touch calibration: touch the tip of the arrow in each corner. The result is saved. To recalibrate, touch the screen just after the S3 is switched on.
Start with /bantuan in Telegram: the bot sends the list of commands.
Try the features in the table below one by one. The wheels stay lifted until Part 6.
Chat freely through Telegram. The AI knows the latest sensor data, so try asking "berapa suhu di sini?" or "baterainya masih cukup?".
